# Facilities and administration checklists

Starting points only. Tailor to the site, headcount and jurisdiction. Items marked (confirm) need a qualified person or the landlord.

## Office move or new site

| Phase | Item | Typical owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before | Confirm lease terms, access dates and building rules (confirm) | Operations lead |
| Before | Floor plan, desk allocation and meeting rooms | Operations lead |
| Before | Network, Wi-Fi, printers and phone lines ordered (lead time is an assumption) | IT Operations |
| Before | Furniture and equipment list, quotes and orders | Procurement |
| Before | Movers booked, inventory and labeling plan | Operations lead |
| Before | Fire exits, alarms, extinguishers and evacuation plan (confirm) | Safety officer or landlord |
| Before | First aid kit and trained first aiders (confirm) | HR or safety officer |
| Before | Accessibility of entrances, restrooms and workstations (confirm) | Operations lead |
| Before | Staff notice with dates and actions | HR |
| During | Access cards or keys issued and recorded | Operations lead |
| During | IT equipment set up and tested | IT Operations |
| After | Snag list and fixes | Operations lead |
| After | Old site handed back and asset records updated | Operations lead and Finance |

## Workplace safety basics (confirm all with a qualified person)

- Risk assessment for the workspace and any hazardous tasks.
- Fire safety: alarms, exits kept clear, extinguishers, drills, a named fire warden.
- First aid provision and an incident or accident log.
- Electrical equipment checks where required.
- Display-screen and ergonomic setup for desk work.
- Emergency contacts posted.

## Supplies and assets

- Reorder levels for consumables, with an owner.
- Asset register: item, tag, location, assigned role, purchase date, warranty end.
- Annual asset check.

## Visitor handling

- Sign-in with only the data needed (name, host, time in and out).
- A stated retention period for visitor records, then deletion (confirm with legal for the jurisdiction).
- Escort and badge rules for restricted areas.
- CCTV, if any: signage and access limits (confirm).
